text: Tameeni, the Saudi insurance-comparison platform, is a subsidiary of Rasan Information Technology Company, a Saudi joint-stock company listed on the Saudi Exchange.
short: Tameeni is a subsidiary of Rasan Information Technology (listed on the Saudi Exchange, Tadawul: 8313).

source.name: Rasan – homepage (company site)
source.quote: Rasan's subsidiary Tameeni signs insurance brokerage agreement with Saudi National Bank

additionalSources.quote: Rasan offers insurance and banking solutions through Tameeni Motor, Tameeni SME Health, AwalMazad, and Treza Motor Leasing.
